family_history.relationship: Different proposed estimand in the existing SEC purchase/sale research family; no inspection reset

existing_estimands.population: Unique selected timing-eligible complete 60-session SEC P/S economic events; excluded/unresolved/missing/censored/terminal records retained in accounting
existing_estimands.weighting: events, not equal issuers or invested capital
existing_estimands.meaning: complete-outcome association, not causal effect, risk-adjusted alpha or portfolio return

candidate.target_population: Future unique SEC Table I purchase candidates under unchanged conservative public/actionable timing, with all status/identity/capacity blocks recorded
candidate.policy_skeleton: Cash-funded long-only entries, public/actionable-time then Event-ID tie order, one live holding per issuer, no repeat-event increase or extension, original 60-session exit
candidate.weights: Nonnegative security weights summing to at most one; residual cash; no leverage or shorting
candidate.benchmark: Separate SPY ledger with matching external flows and explicit benchmark costs/fills; not a short position
candidate.calendar_weighting: Every planned regular session equally, including cash-only/no-event days; missing marks unresolved, never zero or silently deleted
candidate.target: theta_Pi=E[D_t] for a fixed policy under an explicitly justified stable joint event/return/execution process
candidate.interpretation_limit: Different from event contrast, factor-model alpha, causal effect and terminal wealth difference; complete wealth paths and risk remain separate
assumptions_unestablished: complete licensed sampling frame and PIT identities
dependence restrictions sufficient for a specified theorem and uncertainty method
transport to any claimed future population
candidate.dependence: Concurrent holdings, horizon overlap, repeat issuers and persistent common shocks can connect calendar observations; more observations or gaps do not establish independence

analytic_reason.construction: a>0; one symmetric S in {-1,+1} persists throughout; D_t=a*S
analytic_reason.conclusion: Strict stationarity need not imply ergodicity or shrinking mean uncertainty; an observed positive path does not reveal the regime mixture
analytic_reason.scope: Refutes IID precision reasoning; not a universal impossibility theorem for every conservative test

later_numerical_falsification.reason: Policy, population/coverage and dependence premises are unresolved; a finite synthetic pass cannot establish them

single_next_dependency.scope: Explicitly bounded source scope, collection-versus-absence status, unique candidates by day/issuer, timing precision, unresolved identity, repeat issuers and overlapping potential 60-session intervals
single_next_dependency.does_not_establish: Dollar affordability, price/terminal coverage, independence, power, untouched status or positive validation
